exit_codes.name: clean
exit_codes.meaning: No finding at or above the failing severity and no stale suppression.

exit_codes.name: findings
exit_codes.meaning: At least one finding at or above the failing severity, or at least one stale suppression.

exit_codes.name: usage
exit_codes.meaning: Malformed invocation, missing target kind, unimplemented configuration key, unknown symbol in an explanation request, or a requested source edit.

exit_codes.name: failure
exit_codes.meaning: Load, type-check, consumer, configuration-matrix, analyzer-resolution or digest failure.

exit_codes.name: pending
exit_codes.meaning: The report holds at least one pending finding whose cross-language edge has not been evaluated.
